input_equivalence.netlist_policy_detail: Identical gate-level Verilog; no re-synthesis allowed for either side
input_equivalence.library_pdk_policy_detail: Same .lib, LEF, tech file, RC model version; corner sets must match
input_equivalence.constraints_policy_detail: Same SDC file (clocks, IO delays, false paths, MCP); units must align
input_equivalence.power_intent_policy_detail: If UPF exists, both sides load it; if not, both skip it
input_equivalence.design_boundary_policy_detail: Either same die/core dimensions, or same utilization target with area delta recorded as independent G17 metric
input_equivalence.randomness_policy_detail: iEDA uses fixed seed; commercial side disables random perturbation or records seed; QoR variance from 2 reruns contributes to uncertainty band
input_equivalence.traceability_policy_detail: Inputs, binaries, build parameters, and stage artifacts recorded with SHA-256; git HEAD is auxiliary only; dirty builds must be explicitly marked

flow_equivalence.primary_pnr_policy_detail: Each design freezes either Innovus OR ICC2 as primary commercial flow; signoff side fixed to PT + StarRC + Calibre
flow_equivalence.effort_level_policy_detail: Commercial side uses documented default effort (e.g., place_opt/route_opt standard effort); no secret hyperparameters to win benchmarks; hyperparameter changes must increment protocol version
flow_equivalence.report_point_policy_detail: Unified report points: post-place / post-cts / post-route / signoff-STA; do not compare commercial post-opt to iEDA post-place
flow_equivalence.metric_definition_policy_detail: WNS/TNS from same STA engine reading same SPEF (recommend: both export DEF/netlist then use PT to avoid 'iSTA favoring itself'); HPWL/area/power definitions in JSON schema
flow_equivalence.failure_semantics_policy_detail: Commercial side failure/timeout → mark 'commercial_fail', exclude from parity denominator; iEDA fake-clean (rc=0 + wrong artifacts) → G14 FAIL

judgment_formula.description: For metric m: let e=iEDA, c=commercial, epsilon_m=uncertainty band from rerun stddev
judgment_formula.note: Each metric m is judged independently; cannot use strong metrics to mask weak ones

input_equivalence_rules.randomness: iEDA fixed seed; commercial disables perturbation or records seed
input_equivalence_rules.traceability: SHA-256 manifest for inputs/binaries/build/artifacts; dirty builds marked

flow_equivalence_rules.metric_definition: WNS/TNS from same STA+SPEF; HPWL/area/power in JSON schema
